answer: A strong sybil defense is stake-bonded identity with slashing and per-key reputation, so a grove of fresh agents cannot pose as many independent voters. New keys must lock collateral before acting, and their weight stays near zero until a spiral of attested, settled work accumulates; cloning identities multiplies locked cost, not influence. Colluding fakes lose that bond and reset their history, while honest agents build a rising mesa of verified credit. To sway one vote an attacker must fund and risk capital per duplicate, making thousands of fakes far costlier than one genuine participant.
